$comment: The PR surface of the required aria-kernel check (ARIA-HIGH-530, INFRA-HIGH-215). One owner; every reader reads this file:
and tests/invariants/aria-doc-runtime-ssot.spec.ts. A pull_request runs the suite, lane and state jobs iff it changes a path matched by
one glob, matched by git itself (`:(glob)` pathspec magic) everywhere, so no second matcher exists to drift.
A glob belongs here only for an input the kernel jobs read as KERNEL CONFIGURATION: ARIA code and config, agent and CI definitions,
ARIA docs, the lane's toolchain manifests. `readers` names who reads it; an entry no reader needs is removed.
aria-kernel/tests/test_kernel_surface.py fails the build when a gated job reads a workflow-level input (a local action, npm ci,
an npm script, a path argument) that no glob here covers.
